name: assimilate
description: ASSIMILATE — a cyberpunk bio-horror tower defense (playable vertical slice). Static React + TypeScript + Vite app, built for Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p functions/tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs
scripts.dev:full: npm run build && npx wrangler@3 pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@3 pages deploy dist --project-name assimilate
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler@3 d1 migrations apply assimilate-db --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler@3 d1 migrations apply assimilate-db --local
scripts.db:backup: npx wrangler@3 d1 export assimilate-db --remote --output backups/assimilate-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).sql
